boulangerie.name: La boulangerie · Bakery Shop
boulangerie.alt: Inside the village bakery, painted in ink and gouache: a brass till, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret counting on his fingers beside a bowl of coins, Monsieur Verbe in a purple beret selling a baguette, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret holding up a gold coin, a glass display case where the shopkeepers lift out a fruit tart and show off a strawberry cake beside the dough, butter, sugar and a chocolate éclair, with a little green-beret mime choosing, a little girl in a yellow dress slipping a baguette from a tall stack into a paper bag, a sack of flour, a jolly baker juggling croissants beside a price-tag rosette, a sack of baguettes, an egg lifting weights and a child's bike with a wicker pannier; the glass shop door on the left leads out to the village and a purple door on the right opens into the bakehouse.

doors.label: Le fournil
doors.hint: Through the purple door into the bakehouse

comptoir.name: La vitrine · Display Case
comptoir.alt: A close-up of the bakery's glass display case at a busy moment, painted in ink and gouache: behind the glass one shopkeeper mime lifts the fruit tart out with a cake server while the other turns the tall strawberry cake on its stand to show it off; the ball of dough pats its tummy in a puff of flour, the butter shivers in its scarf and earmuffs on a dish of ice, a lollipop stands in a bowl of sparkling sugar cubes and a little mouse sniffs the chocolate éclair with its yellow lightning icing, while in front of the case Monsieur Verbe as a little boy in a green beret taps his chin, choosing.

fournil.name: Le fournil · Bakehouse
fournil.alt: The bakehouse behind the shop, painted in ink and gouache: a purple arched door back to the shop, where the mimes can be seen behind the display case, a gasping water pitcher and a pair of scales on a shelf, a pelican carrying a loaf on a baker's peel, a pile of logs by a bush, Monsieur Verbe in a green beret kneading dough in a giant petri dish, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret mixing batter in half a watermelon, Monsieur Verbe in a gold beret and choir collar singing as he cooks a pancake, a brick oven beside which a baker in a chef's hat holds up four fingers, a tray on a little rocky mesa, a leaky bucket by the oven sewn up with a needle and red thread, a smiling apron-table, and a workbench where a slice of bread in a trench coat inspects a puddle with a sailing cake box, a salt shaker shakes salt from its stone cell, an alarm clock blows a bugle at a rearing toy mule in a cake pan and a knight's gauntlet carries a steaming loaf. A half-open wooden back door behind the stirring mime gives a glimpse of the butcher's shop next door.

doors.label: La boutique
doors.hint: Back through the purple door into the shop

zooms.label: la boucherie
zooms.hint: Peek through the half-open back door into the butcher's next door

plan.name: Le plan de travail · Worktop
plan.alt: A close-up of the bakehouse workbench in the middle of a little commotion, painted in ink and gouache: a slice of bread in a trench coat inspects a spilled puddle through a magnifying glass, where a cake box with a sail floats like a boat and drips off the edge; a salt shaker locked in a little stone cell shakes salt out through the bars, an alarm clock blows a brass bugle, a toy mule on wheels wearing a cake pan rears up at the noise, and a knight's gauntlet carries a tray with a steaming loaf, while a baker's shoes hurry past behind.

boucherie.name: La boucherie · Butcher & Fishmonger
boucherie.alt: The busy butcher and fishmonger next door, seen through the bakehouse back door: a girl carrying a big tied roast of meat on a platter, a salmon fillet lying on a little kitchen chair while a sauce boat pours beside a string of fresh sausages, a side of meat hanging on a hook, a mule peeking in at the window with panniers of black mussels, an open can of sardines, a shark-shaped board of sliced cured meats, a carved galloping horse on the wall, a dried salami with white bloom hanging on a string, a whole salmon on ice beside pink salmon steaks, a jolly butcher with a big fish on ice next to an open pea pod, a boy patting a terrine of pâté, a ham with a jar of jam on top, and pork chops beside a pink piggy bank.
